PROGRAM zcv_form_locals.

* A FORM's local data is its own, also next to a FORM that suspends and next
* to MODULE data of the same name, which is a member.
MODULE show OUTPUT.
  DATA lv_value TYPE string.
  lv_value = 'module'.
  PERFORM show_text.
  PERFORM confirm.
  PERFORM ask_number.
  PERFORM show_number.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE ask INPUT.
  PERFORM confirm.
ENDMODULE.

FORM show_text.
  DATA lv_value TYPE c LENGTH 10.
  lv_value = 'text'.
ENDFORM.

FORM confirm.
  DATA lv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Go?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = lv_answer.
  IF lv_answer = '1'.
    MESSAGE 'yes' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

FORM ask_number.
  DATA lv_answer TYPE i.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Number?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = lv_answer.
  IF lv_answer = 1.
    MESSAGE 'one' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

FORM show_number.
  DATA lv_value TYPE i.
  lv_value = lv_value + 1.
ENDFORM.
